description: Source code for the FileStream::Context class handling asynchronous file operations in the net namespace, including open, close, seek, get file info, and flush functionalities with platform-specific considerations.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file operations such as open, close, seek, get info, and flush, with platform-specific behavior and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: FileStream::Context::IOResult
classes.description: Represents the result of IO operations, including success or error codes.

classes.name: FileStream::Context::OpenResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of an open operation, including the file handle and error code.

methods.name: Orphan
methods.description: Marks the context as orphaned and initiates cleanup if no async operation is in progress.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a file with specified flags and callback.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Asynchronously closes the file with callback.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Asynchronously seeks to a specified offset in the file.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open.

methods.name: OpenFileImpl
methods.description: Platform-specific implementation to open a file.

methods.name: GetFileInfoImpl
methods.description: Platform-specific implementation to get file info.

methods.name: CloseFileImpl
methods.description: Platform-specific implementation to close a file.

methods.name: FlushFileImpl
methods.description: Platform-specific implementation to flush a file.

methods.name: OnOpenCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of open operation.

methods.name: CloseAndDelete
methods.description: Closes the file and deletes the context object.

methods.name: IntToInt64
methods.description: Converts a callback to operate with int64 result.

methods.name: OnAsyncCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous operations, resetting state and invoking callback.
